answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation with slow decay: each agent must lock a bond in escrow before earning, and reputation grows only through attested work over time. A sybil attacker must fund a separate bond for every fake identity and wait out the same slow ramp, so cost scales linearly with each clone. Like an orchard, trust is grown, not bought overnight; a whisper of doubt follows any agent that burns its bond, and unlike an ivory tower design, the rules are public so honest agents can verify them.
